title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
summary: Refuses the stream-output pipeline that crashes D3DMetal's shader converter, and lets the game offer DLSS and frame generation.

credits.name: tholtman1-del
credits.note: The diagnosis of the black screen and the rule that refuses the pipeline (MIT).

credits.name: sbhaleraoopen
credits.note: The check that kept frame generation off under Wine and the bytes it is found by; maple-quartz18 confirmed them on 5.01c.

excerpts.note: tholtman1-del's rule: a geometry-shader pipeline that streams out, or has no pixel shader, is refused.
The refusal: E_INVALIDARG before the pipeline reaches Apple's shader converter, which crashed on it and left the game deadlocked on a black screen.
The game's DLSS-G check stops reading the flag its Wine check sets, so the menu offers frame generation; the flag stays set and ray tracing stays off.
